sqlquery.from: ( SELECT v.id as vid, max(vst.code) as status, max(v.jobtitle) as jobtitle, max(v.description) as description, max(po.name) as position, max(coalesce(man.firstName,'')||' '||coalesce(man.lastname,'')) as manager, max(replace((coalesce(cont.name,'')||','||coalesce(stat.name,'')||','||coalesce(loc.city,'')),',','')) as location, array_to_string(array_agg(coalesce(can.firstname,'')||' '||coalesce(can.lastname,'')), ',') as matchedcandidates, max(v.startdate) as startdate, max(v.enddate) as enddate, max(v.lastupdatedtime) as updateddate, count(can.id) as amount FROM "$".vacancy v LEFT JOIN "$".candidate_vacancies cv ON (cv.vacancy_id=v.id) LEFT JOIN "$".crmcontact can ON (cv.candidate_id=can.id) LEFT OUTER JOIN "$".myUser man ON (man.id = v.manager_id) LEFT OUTER JOIN "$".position po ON (po.id = v.position_id) LEFT OUTER JOIN "$".location loc ON (loc.id = v.location_id) LEFT OUTER JOIN "public".country cont ON (cont.id = loc.countryid) LEFT OUTER JOIN "public".region stat ON (stat.id = loc.stateid) LEFT OUTER JOIN "$".reference vst ON (vst.id = v.status_id) LEFT OUTER JOIN "$".reference req ON (req.id = v.requireddegree_id), (select u.id, max(case when r.code in ('ADMIN','DR','HR') then 1 else 0 end) isAdmin from "$".myuser u left join "$".myuser_role mu on mu.users_id=u.id left join "$".role r on mu.roles_id=r.id where u.id=#?user_id?# group by u.id) x WHERE v.deleted is not true and ( x.isAdmin=1 or ( x.isAdmin != 1 and v.manager_id=x.id) ) GROUP BY vid ) t
